description: Return the metadata of the scoring method behind the current FORUM release: method_version, as_of_input_date, record_count, merkle_root, the record hash_recipe and freshness thresholds (the same object as GET /v1/method on the FORUM HTTP API), plus pointers with SHA-256 to the full method document (/v1/method/doc; section 10 holds the verification recipes), the weights file and the release manifest, and the path of the signing keys. The method is public and versioned; weights live in a published config file. What a score is NOT: Not a security guarantee, not a penetration test, not certification of code correctness. It is a longitudinal behavioral-reputation summary with full evidence disclosure: scanners answer "is this safe to install today"; FORUM answers "what has this thing done since everyone installed it". Scores are flags, not verdicts: the band is derived only from the documented sub-scores, and a sub-score FORUM could not observe is reported as null with a reason, not estimated. Takes no arguments. Read-only.
name: get_method
title: FORUM scoring method metadata
